description: Deploy web frontend for AWS Security Chatbot
context: Created simple HTML/JS chatbot interface with clean UI and API integration ready
Created web API Lambda function (chatbot-web-api) with Bedrock Agent integration and CORS support
Created API Gateway (hinh3actqf) with /chat endpoint connected to Lambda function. API URL: https://hinh3actqf.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prod/chat
Ready to deploy frontend to S3. React app is built and ready for static hosting.
Frontend deployed to S3 successfully! Website URL: http://aws-security-chatbot-ui-2024.s3-website-us-east-1.amazonaws.com. Ready to test CORS and functionality.
